newsitem.title: USA: Infinite Machines loses suit vs Moller.
newsitem.headline: Infinite Machines loses suit vs Moller.

text.p: Infinite Machines Corp said on Thursday a jury ruled against it in a lawsuit with Moller International Inc and Infinite Machines had compensatory damages of $1.25 million assessed against it.
A verdict was rendered in favor of Moller on the company's counterclaims, Infinity said.

The dispute involves allegations Infinite breached its rotary engine development contract with Moller and that Infinite's chief executive officer Carle Conway breached certain fiduciary duties to Moller, Infinite said.
The company said it believed the jury verdict contradicted both documentary evidence and applicable law and it intended to appeal the decision.
